topic: Modular newform elimination at levels dividing 576 for Kraus Frey curve attached to A^3 + B^3 = C^p

primary_sources.title: Sur l'equation a^3 + b^3 = c^p
primary_sources.relevance: Construction of Frey curve E_{A, B}, level lowering to levels dividing 72/576, and introduction of the Kraus sieve method with auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1

primary_sources.title: Classical and modular methods for exponential Diophantine equations
primary_sources.relevance: Detailed treatment of Kraus method (Section 2.2), Example 53 (CM elimination of 36a1), and Table 3.3 verification for small primes

primary_sources.title: Sums of two cubes as twisted perfect powers, revisited
primary_sources.relevance: Minimal Weierstrass models F^(0) and F^(1), conductor classification Lemma 2.1, and 2-torsion classification at levels dividing 72q

primary_sources.title: Recipes for Fermat-type equations of the form x^r + y^r = C z^p
primary_sources.relevance: The Symplectic Method: unconditional elimination of 72a1 for all p = 2 mod 3

primary_sources.title: Chabauty methods and covering techniques applied to generalized Fermat equations
